rationale: The agent located the user and relevant orders/products and executed an exchange consistent with the user’s stated preferences (one size smaller, black, cotton). However, it violated key policy requirements: it performed an order-changing write (exchange_delivered_order_items) without first obtaining explicit user confirmation, and authentication was ambiguous (searched two emails but did not confirm identity with the user before acting). It also committed to using the PayPal payment method without prior confirmation. These issues fail the pass bar even though the requested outcome was achieved.
